description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of SetLoanDelinquencyTagsBusinessStep, a component involved in managing loan delinquency tags within the Fineract platform. It includes setup for context, dependency mocks, and multiple test scenarios for executing the step, handling nulls, exceptions, and verifying method outputs.
